title: Before Morning

locks.character: SUBJECT — an elegant European woman of 27, refined features, high cheekbones, clean jawline, calm dark eyes, glossy dark-chestnut hair in a blunt shoulder-length cut with soft natural movement, groomed brows, minimal satin-neutral makeup with defined lashes and no lip gloss, straight composed posture. She wears a fitted single-breasted charcoal wool sports blazer with a sharp shoulder and nipped waist, an ivory fine-knit silk shell underneath, slim tailored black trousers cropped at the ankle, black leather loafers with a slim silver bit, a fine silver chain and small silver hoop earrings. She carries a structured black leather cabin bag.
locks.vehicle: VEHICLE — a black compact German performance sedan, BMW M340i, gloss black paintwork with dark chrome trim and black 19-inch double-spoke wheels, warm ivory leather interior with dark open-pore wood, athletic understated proportions, showroom clean.
locks.aircraft: AIRCRAFT — a SWISS International Air Lines Airbus A220, white fuselage, red tail with a white cross, red wingtip navigation light, clean livery.
locks.photography: STYLE — shot on large-format digital with anamorphic spherical primes, shallow but controlled depth of field, restrained camera movement on dolly or gimbal, real physical reflections and practical light sources, realistic skin texture with visible pores, deep blacks with no lifted shadows, subtle 35mm film grain, desaturated cool-to-warm grade, mature European commercial photography.
locks.continuity: CONTINUITY — the woman's face, hair, makeup and clothing are identical to the reference in every frame. The car is the identical vehicle in every frame.
locks.negative: smiling at camera, influencer posing, gown, evening dress, champagne, slow-motion hair flip, cyberpunk or neon lighting, lens flare spam, orbiting drone shot, drifting, wheelspin, impossible car motion, floating or morphing car body, warped wheels, extra fingers, distorted hands, plastic skin, beauty-retouched face, text overlays, subtitles, watermarks, fake or garbled logos, misspelled signage, HDR glow, oversaturated colours, vertical format

shots.title: Descent
shots.beat: The world before the film starts. She wakes into it.
shots.camera: Locked exterior wide, aircraft moving frame-left to frame-right with slight parallax. Cut mid-shot to interior close on her eyes opening.
shots.sound: Muffled cabin roar under everything. Score is a single felt-piano note with no rhythm yet.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — cabin interior of an aircraft at night in low amber light. The woman sits asleep against the oval window in a premium cabin seat, her charcoal architectural wool overcoat folded on the seat beside her, eyes just opening. Orange runway approach lights far below through the window. Locked-off camera, 40mm.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — exterior night aerial: the aircraft descends through thick dark cloud toward Zurich, landing lights cutting the moisture, city glow bleeding through the cloud base below. Cut to the cabin interior in low amber night lighting: the woman sleeps against the window, her charcoal overcoat folded beside her. She wakes slowly, unhurried, and turns toward the window as the orange runway approach lights slide into view beneath the wing. Camera locked off, no push.

shots.title: The Espresso
shots.beat: Somebody is looking after her. The SWISS promise played as behaviour, not as a logo.
shots.camera: Two-shot at seat level, 40mm, very slow push. Stay on hands as the cup lands, then lift to faces.
shots.sound: Porcelain on the console — the first hard sound in the film.
shots.dialogue: Attendant: Good morning. We'll be in Zurich shortly.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — aircraft cabin at night, warm low light, other passengers asleep. A poised SWISS flight attendant, mid-30s, dark hair in a low chignon, in a tailored red and navy airline uniform, leans in and sets a small white espresso cup and saucer on the console beside the woman, who is turning to look up at her. Two-shot at seat level, 40mm.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — aircraft cabin at night. A poised SWISS flight attendant, mid-30s, dark hair in a low chignon, in a tailored red and navy airline uniform, leans in and places a small white espresso cup and saucer on the console beside the woman, and speaks quietly to her. The woman lifts her eyes, nods once in thanks, and adjusts the blazer at her shoulder. Warm low cabin light, everyone else asleep. Natural understated interaction, no exaggerated smiling. Very slow camera push in.

shots.title: The Coat
shots.beat: The handover of care. Before this door she is a passenger being looked after; after it she is a woman in motion.
shots.camera: Tight. 75mm. Hands, shoulders, the fabric settling. One clean cut to faces on the line.
shots.sound: Wool. A seatbelt chime somewhere behind. The cabin door seal.
shots.dialogue: Attendant: Welcome to Zurich. / Her: Thank you. It was lovely.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — at the aircraft door in the vestibule, cool white jet bridge light spilling in. The same SWISS flight attendant holds open a charcoal architectural wool overcoat behind the woman, who is sliding one arm into the sleeve over her charcoal blazer. A second crew member in matching red and navy uniform stands beside them holding her structured black leather cabin bag. Tight framing, 75mm, on hands and shoulders.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — at the aircraft door in the vestibule, cool white light from the jet bridge spilling in. The same SWISS flight attendant holds open a charcoal architectural wool overcoat and helps the woman into it; the coat settles over her charcoal blazer and she draws it closed without belting it. A second crew member in the same red and navy uniform passes her the structured black leather cabin bag. Close on hands, shoulders and small gestures. Quiet mutual courtesy, restrained.

shots.title: The Match Cut
shots.beat: THE SIGNATURE MOMENT. Aircraft red navigation light to BMW red taillight. This cut is the whole campaign in one frame. Protect it.
shots.camera: Steadicam follows her from behind down the jet bridge, crew held soft behind her. Rack to the red light through the window. Cut.
shots.sound: Score drops to near-silence one frame before the cut. Let the cut land naked.
shots.note: Signature moment. Cut on the pulse of the red light. Final frame must match shot 05 opening frame in size, position and luminance.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — the woman seen from behind, walking away down an empty curved jet bridge under cold white fluorescent light, wearing the charcoal overcoat open over her blazer, cabin bag in hand. Two SWISS crew members small and soft-focus behind her at the aircraft door. Through the jet bridge window, the red wingtip navigation light of the aircraft glows against black wet apron.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — the woman walks away from camera down an empty curved jet bridge in cold white fluorescent light, cabin bag in hand, coat moving with her stride. The two SWISS crew members remain framed small and soft behind her at the aircraft door. Through the jet bridge window, the red wingtip navigation light of the aircraft pulses against the black wet apron. Camera glides behind her, then racks focus to the pulsing red light until it fills the frame.

shots.title: The Key
shots.beat: The literal handoff — the airline hands her off to the car.
shots.camera: Opens tight on the taillight (match frame), pulls back to reveal the car under the canopy, then a clean two-shot for the key.
shots.sound: Trunk closing — solid, expensive, a single thunk. Key into palm.
shots.note: The literal SWISS to BMW handoff.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — extreme close-up on the glowing red taillight of the car, parked on wet black pavement beneath a lit terminal canopy at Zurich Airport before dawn, rain beads on the paint. Framed so the red light sits at the exact centre of frame at the same scale as an aircraft navigation light.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — extreme close on the glowing red taillight of the car parked beneath a wet terminal canopy at Zurich Airport before dawn; camera pulls smoothly back to reveal the whole car, rain-beaded and reflecting the canopy lights on black pavement. A sharply dressed airport host in a dark charcoal suit and tie lifts the structured black leather cabin bag into the open trunk, closes it with one hand, and turns to place a black car key into the open palm of the woman. She takes it without ceremony. Wet asphalt, empty forecourt, blue pre-dawn light against warm sodium canopy light.

shots.title: Ignition
shots.beat: She exhales. The score opens up here. The moment she stops being a passenger.
shots.camera: Interior, passenger-side profile, 50mm. Door closes and the world goes quiet. Slow drift toward her face, then out to the departure.
shots.sound: Door seal, then near-total silence, then the straight-six start — low and civilised. Indicator ticks. The rhythmic pulse enters on the second tick.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — interior of the car, passenger-side profile view at 50mm. The woman sits in the warm ivory leather driver's seat having just closed the door, coat still on, eyes forward, mid-exhale. Runway and taxiway lights glow softly through the windscreen and glide across her face.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — interior of the car. The woman settles into the warm ivory leather driver's seat and pulls the door closed; the exterior noise drops away. She sits still for a moment and exhales, eyes forward, shoulders lowering. She presses the start button and the instrument cluster wakes. Runway and taxiway lights glide slowly across her face and across the windscreen glass. The car pulls away along the wet perimeter road as, beyond the fence in the background, the aircraft taxis slowly in the opposite direction. Camera holds inside the car, drifting gently toward her profile.

shots.title: The Road
shots.beat: She is in control now. One small private smile — never to camera.
shots.camera: Cut-driven montage on the music. Five micro-beats, roughly 1.5s each.
shots.sound: Tyres, tunnel reverb, one clean throttle swell on the bend. Strings open on the lake reveal.
shots.note: If the model softens across five beats, split into 07A (parts 1-3, 4s) and 07B (parts 4-5, 4s).
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — the car entering a concrete airport tunnel at speed, overhead sodium lights streaking along the gloss black bodywork, low tracking angle from the side, pre-dawn.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — a driving sequence cut in five parts. One: the car enters a concrete airport tunnel, overhead sodium lights strobing rhythmically along the gloss black bodywork. Two: close on the woman's hands resting easy on the flat-bottomed steering wheel, the silver chain at her wrist catching the tunnel light. Three: low tracking shot alongside the car on an empty Swiss motorway, the sky shifting from black to deep blue. Four: wide of the car on a clean lakeside road beside Lake Lucerne at sunrise, still water, mountains behind, pale gold light on the water. Five: the car takes one controlled Alpine bend, weight settling on the outside wheels, tyres gripping cleanly, no drift and no wheelspin, and inside she allows herself one small private smile.

shots.title: Andermatt
shots.beat: She has arrived, but she doesn't rush inside. The film ends on her choosing to stand still.
shots.camera: Wide, locked, symmetrical. Let her be small against the mountains.
shots.sound: Engine ticking as it cools. Wind. Distant aircraft, barely there. Strings resolve to F major and hold. Cut to black on the held note.
shots.reference_frame_prompt: SHOT — morning outside a severe modernist alpine hotel in Andermatt, dark stone and glass against snow-dusted peaks. The car is parked at the entrance. The woman stands beside the open driver's door, one hand resting on the roof, looking up toward the mountains. A doorman in a dark grey coat stands respectfully to one side. Locked symmetrical wide.
shots.video_prompt: SHOT — morning outside a severe modernist alpine hotel in Andermatt, dark stone and glass against snow-dusted peaks. The car is parked at the entrance, engine heat shimmering faintly from the bonnet. A doorman in a dark grey coat steps forward and opens the driver's door with a small nod of recognition. The woman steps out, but pauses beside the car with one hand resting on the roof, and looks up toward the mountains as the first sunlight reaches the highest peaks. Far above and very small, the aircraft crosses the pale blue sky leaving a thin contrail. Camera locked wide and symmetrical, no movement.
